base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace')
programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
program=programs/'task-5705c457.py'
source='''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    full_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 4 for v in row)]\n    full_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 4 for r in range(h))]\n    for r in full_rows:\n        for c in range(w):\n            out[r][c] = 2\n    for c in full_cols:\n        for r in range(h):\n            out[r][c] = 2\n    return out\n'''
program.write_text(source)
